facts.claim: NDVI uses red and near-infrared reflected light to study vegetation.
MOD13Q1 Version 6.1 is a Terra/MODIS Level 3 vegetation product with 16-day composites and 250 m spatial resolution.
The incorporated package has six historical records, three requested points near Rio Verde and two periods in 2024; composite starts differ from selected observation dates.
Unexpectedly rocky terrain prompted additional evaluation of sample sites using imagery; more than 50 candidate sites were narrowed to four and Nightingale was selected in December 2019.
OSIRIS-REx collected material on 2020-10-20; its sample capsule returned to Earth on 2023-09-24.
The game’s A/B/C regions and six roughness values are synthetic teaching data, not named sample sites or OSIRIS-REx telemetry.
NASA announced CO2 evidence in WASP-39 b’s atmosphere on 2022-08-25 from a NIRSpec observation on 2022-07-10, with a feature between 4.1 and 4.6 micrometers.
All four Webb science instruments have spectrographs, including NIRCam; the game’s generic camera is not a model of NIRCam.
The game’s six relative fluxes at 1.2, 2.0 and 3.5 micrometers are synthetic; they do not reproduce WASP-39 b or its documented CO2 feature.
Ipê refers to the team name. The tree is not the scientific theme of the missions.
NASA 3D reference geometry does not validate the game’s power, mass, trajectory or instrument assumptions.
